entries.title: Jeremiah 52:1
segments: This chapter is mostly a repetition of

entries.title: Jeremiah 52:27
segments: Thus Judah was carried away captive; in the three captivities mentioned in

entries.title: Jeremiah 52:28
segments: Three thousand--three and twenty; to these must be added seven thousand soldiers, making the whole number of captives in this first captivity, in round numbers, ten thousand, as in

entries.title: Jeremiah 52:30
segments: Seven hundred forty and five--all the persons were four thousand and six hundred; adding the seven thousand soldiers, we have, for the total number of adult males, eleven thousand six hundred. Reckoning women and children, the number may have been fifty thousand or more.
